title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Maya Chen
body:
This PR adds a set of reusable RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples (Python + TS), and updates the docs site quickstarts to include step-by-step onboarding for RAG agents and tool integration. Motivation: customers frequently ask for end-to-end examples that combine retrieval-augmented generation, structured tool calling, and deployment guidance. These artifacts reduce time-to-value and surface recommended patterns for prompt templates, retrieval configs, and safe tool schemas.

What I changed (summary):
- New examples under redwood-examples/rag-agents/: generic agent templates, sample retrievers, and test harnesses.
- Quickstart guides for docs site (redwood-docs/content/quickstarts/rag-agent-quickstart.md) with copy+paste snippets for Python/TS SDKs.
- Tool-calling examples illustrating function schemas, invocation patterns, and error handling (redwood-examples/tool-calling/).
- Small runtime compatibility shim in redwood/client to expose tool-call metadata on streaming responses (non-breaking; feature-flagged).
- Updated README and contributing docs for example maintainers.

Testing and validation:
- Local unit tests for example harnesses added (examples_test.py, examples_test.ts).
- Docs site build passes locally and on CI (site build + linkcheck).
- Manual end-to-end smoke tests: start local redis retriever, run example agent, and execute tool call flow.

Related linear tickets: ENG-3245 (RAG agent templates), ENG-3318 (tool-calling examples), DES-198 (docs quickstart copy). Links to internal design notes included in PR description.

Notes for reviewers:
- The runtime shim is behind the feature flag FEATURE_TOOL_CALL_META and is no-op unless enabled. Please pay attention to the API surface in redwood/client/streaming.ts and the compatibility tests.
- Examples are intentionally small and opinionated; we can expand in follow-ups to cover more retrievers (vector DBs, llm-index connectors).

Checklist:
- [x] Add example templates and quickstarts
- [x] Add unit + smoke tests
- [x] Docs site update and linkcheck
- [x] Feature flag for runtime change

Merge notes: squash merge, will include condensed changelog for docs release.
